bundles.evidenceText: they are geared primarily towards understanding the universe around us
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that a Christian creator account makes human minds truth-directed and the universe intelligible, whereas unguided evolution prioritizes reproductive success. This directly supports the subsidiary bridge that an intelligent creator grounds trust in reason and intelligibility. Support polarity therefore fits; option-1 is excluded because the move does not attack that bridge.

bundles.evidenceText: he knows what it is to suffer
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that God entered human suffering, understands it, accompanies sufferers, and that established theodicies receive serious attention. Those propositions can remain true while pervasive apparently gratuitous suffering is improbable under an all-powerful, all-loving God and merely possible theodicies remain insufficient for rational belief. The compatibility check therefore requires no contact; option-1 is excluded because the move does not attack a necessary premise or inference of the pro suffering bridge.

bundles.evidenceText: very much explained for us being a social species
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that evolved sociality explains care, appreciation of sacrifice, religious motifs, and moral intuitions. This directly supports the pro subsidiary bridge that evolutionary accounts of morality undercut treating moral experience as rational identification of God. Option-2 is excluded because explaining the origin of moral intuitions does not directly attack the distinct con proposition about grounding objective moral obligations.
